dataHubModel.description: Mercedes-Benz customer master data: individuals and companies consolidated across the dealer, CRM, fleet, online and self-service channels, with the contexts, contact points, identifiers, consents and dealer relationships that make a customer usable by a market while keeping markets and legal entities apart.
dataHubModel.label: Customer MDM

retentionPolicy.description: Five years of change history, so every merge, un-merge and correction stays retrievable for the audit trail.

applications.description: Manage the consolidated Mercedes-Benz customer data: people, companies, the contexts they are known in, their contact points, identifiers, consents and dealer relationships.
applications.label: Customer MDM

documentationConfig.documentation: Proof of concept for the future Mercedes-Benz customer master data platform. Covers duplicate identification and resolution, the customer lifecycle up to deletion, and the separation of markets and legal entities.

entities.description:
The relationship between a customer context and a Mercedes-Benz sales entity. It is this relationship that entitles a sales entity to see the customer.

AI agent instructions: The relationship counts as active for two years after the last interaction, and every interaction resets that clock. A sales entity may search for a customer it has no active relationship with, but may not browse them.
